# Bellcourt Homes

> Cross-border property advisory helping resident Indian investors buy new-build residential property in London, using India's Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS). Based in Mumbai, with a delivery team in London.

## What Bellcourt Homes does
- Guides resident Indian investors (not NRIs/OCIs) through buying property in the UK, from LRS remittance staging through to solicitor-coordinated legal completion.
- Works with a small, developer-vetted shortlist of London new-build mandates rather than a broad listings portal.
- Free resource: "The 2026 LRS & TCS Roadmap" — explains remittance staging, SDLT, TCS refundability, and net-yield math for a resident Indian buyer.
- Process: (1) a fit & funding call with the Mumbai team, (2) a virtual walkthrough of the shortlisted property, (3) solicitor-coordinated closing. No requirement to travel to the UK to complete a purchase.

## Current live inventory (see /#pathways for details, prices are typical entry points and change; always confirm current pricing on the site)
- Canary Wharf — off-plan release, typical entry £440K+ (developer name embargoed pending public launch; referred to generically as "Canary Wharf")
- Nine Elms / Embassy Gardens — "The Capston" (Ballymore), off-plan, typical entry £770K+, completion estimated Q3–Q4 2028
- Harrow — "Eastman Village" (Barratt London), ready for immediate possession, typical entry £325K+

## Key facts for India-side compliance (subject to change — verify current rules before advising)
- LRS allows a resident Indian individual to remit up to USD 250,000 per financial year (April–March) for permitted purposes, including overseas property purchase.
- TCS (Tax Collected at Source) applies to LRS remittances; under current rules it is nil on the first ₹10 lakh remitted in a financial year and 20% on the remainder for property purchases, and is claimable as a credit against income tax liability.
- Any rental yield or price figures on this site are developer/agent estimates, not guarantees.
